name: System Messages Override
description: Replace the wording of Drupal's core status, warning and error messages from an admin config form, without code.
project_description: Overrides Drupal's core messenger service with a custom Messenger subclass that, on every addMessage() call, matches the incoming message against a list of original/new pairs stored in config and swaps the wording. Configured at /admin/config/system/messages-override behind a restrict-access permission. Handles plain strings, TranslatableMarkup (matched on the untranslated string, arguments and options preserved) and any Stringable/Markup object. An optional Debug mode logs every message string to dblog so the exact text to match can be copied. Errors during override fall back to a preserved copy of the core messenger to avoid breaking the page.
